notes: Exalted: The Autochthonians supplied and intake in progress. 57 rows reviewed and inventoried under docs/references/exalted1e/alchemical/inventory/: the Chapter Two character-creation overview (plus bonus-point/experience-cost tables), the universal Anima Effect/Anima Banner table, the Alchemical Physiology section (Artificial Metabolism, Life and Death, Refitting/Essence Advancement/Evolution), all five Castes (Orichalcum, Moonsilver, Jade, Starmetal, Soulsteel) plus the apocryphal Adamant Caste sidebar, the full Clarity Trait (gain/loss/effects table) and its Dissonance/Gremlin Syndrome mirror, the new/altered Backgrounds (Class, Vats, Artifact, Backing, Familiar, Manse) plus the Building Vats in Creation sidebar and the Followers/Influence/Resources exclusion note, Chapter Three's Charm-system framing (Charm Slots/Panoplies/Submodules/Arrays, Designing New Charms, Eclipse/Moonshadow access, Charm format/limitations), the two General Charms, and the complete Close Combat and Ranged Combat Charm trees (26 Charms plus the Alchemical Martial Artists sidebar). Nothing promoted to a production catalog yet. Chapter Three's remaining Charm trees (Might and Mobility onward), the Man-Machine/God-Machine Weaving Engine Charms and the full weaving-protocol catalog (Chapter Four), the rest of Chapter Four (Miracles of the Machine God), and Chapters Five through Seven (the three adventure chapters) are not yet inventoried. Locked pending the remaining inventory, schema/rules/creator/editor implementation, and passing tests across all five planned families.
